meta.title: An invited vendor can remove a competitor who has not bid yet
gaps: the plan has the vendor send PATCH /v1/trade/remove_audience, but the vendor's session may not call PATCH /v1/trade/remove_audience (trade#remove_audience_live_auction is not on that app's list in config/app_auth_config.yml)
the case reads as “it is accepted”, but the plan checks “the app answers without a server error”

words.preconditions: A fresh RFQ event, published, with one QA vendor invited; bidding open for about 20 minutes.
steps: The invited QA vendor sends the trade remove audience request, exactly as the matching library case writes it.
words.expected: The app answers cleanly — accepted or refused — but never with a server error.
